skill.name: share
skill.description: Create or update shareable, commentable p11 documents for proposals, briefs, reports, specs, plans, memos, and reviews.
skill.summary: Creates polished p11 documents and publishes shareable review links.
skill.author: rarexlabs

security_audit.summary: Most static matches are false positives from Markdown code ticks and component names, not Ruby backtick execution. I confirmed the instructions that install or run external p11 CLI commands, publish documents, allow custom API targets, and handle bearer edit URLs. No prompt injection attempt was found.

remediation.issue: Global CLI installation and npx fallback can execute newly downloaded package code.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before installing or upgrading p11, and prefer a pinned trusted version over latest.

remediation.issue: The share workflow publishes document content to the configured p11 service.
remediation.suggestion: Ask for confirmation before sharing sensitive drafts and state which p11 API endpoint will receive the document.

remediation.issue: Edit URLs are bearer credentials that can modify or delete shared documents.
remediation.suggestion: Return edit URLs only to the requester and avoid placing them in public documents, logs, or issue trackers.

content.value_statement: Teams need polished documents that reviewers can open and comment on. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code publish p11 review links.
actual_capabilities: Guides creation or updates of static p11 React document files.
Runs p11 CLI commands to share new documents or update existing links.
Requests read and edit URLs after successful publication.
Checks authored documents against p11 component and interaction limits.
limitations: Requires access to the p11 CLI or npm package installation.
Publishes content to the configured p11 service when sharing.
Does not support interactive app UI, forms, tabs, or navigation.
Edit URLs act as bearer credentials and must be handled carefully.

use_cases.title: Publish a proposal
use_cases.description: Turn a proposal draft into a structured p11 document with a review link.

use_cases.title: Share an engineering spec
use_cases.description: Create a static spec document that teammates can read and comment on.

use_cases.title: Update a review memo
use_cases.description: Revise an existing p11 document using its edit URL and return updated links.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Review Link
prompt_templates.prompt: Use share to turn my draft into a polished p11 document and publish a read link for comments.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Proposal Document
prompt_templates.prompt: Use share to create a structured proposal from these notes. Include context, options, recommendation, and next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Update an Existing Document
prompt_templates.prompt: Use share to update this p11 document with the provided edit URL. Preserve the core structure and return both links.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Board Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Use share to create a concise board brief from this material. Validate supported components before publishing, then summarize any errors.

output_examples.input: A product proposal with goals, risks, and open questions.
output_examples.output: A published p11 proposal with clear sections and read and edit URLs.

output_examples.input: An engineering spec that needs team comments.
output: A shareable read link for reviewers.
A private edit link for future updates.

output_examples.input: An existing p11 edit URL and revised memo text.
output_examples.output: An updated p11 memo with the latest content and refreshed links.

best_practices: Confirm the document can be shared before running the p11 publish command.
Keep sensitive material out of documents unless the user approves publication.
Protect edit URLs and send them only to the requesting user.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill to build interactive app screens or forms.
Do not publish confidential drafts without explicit user approval.
Do not paste edit URLs into public documents or issue trackers.

faq.question: Does this skill create normal React apps?
faq.answer: No. It creates static p11 documents using document-safe components.

faq.question: Can it update an existing p11 link?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the edit URL and revised content to update the document.

faq.question: Does it require the p11 CLI?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow depends on the p11 CLI or the approved npm package fallback.

faq.question: What links does it return?
faq.answer: It returns a read URL for reviewers and an edit URL for future changes.

faq.question: Can I use custom p11 API endpoints?
faq.answer: Yes, but only when you intentionally target a non-default p11 API.

faq.question: Is the edit URL sensitive?
faq.answer: Yes. Treat it like a bearer credential because it can update or delete the document.
